robot.name: EngineAI SE01
robot.status_notes: Announced in October 2024. SE01 is still listed on the official EngineAI website but no customer deployment or sales have been confirmed. The company later released PM01 and T800, which are now emphasized.
intended_use_cases: potential industrial and assistive applications (per unofficial descriptions)

height.notes: Official EngineAI homepage lists 170CM. DigiAlps blog reports 1.6 m, but official value is used; conflict noted in researcher_notes.

weight.notes: Wikipedia reports 55 kg; DigiAlps also says 55 kg.

payload.notes: No payload specification found in any reviewed source.

runtime.notes: Only from unofficial reseller africasatellite.com; not confirmed by official sources.

battery.notes: Quick-swap / quick-release battery design mentioned by africasatellite.com; capacity not disclosed.

walking_speed.notes: Official website lists '2M/s Normal Walking Speed'; Wikipedia also reports 2 m/s.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Total DOF from official site and Wikipedia.

hands.description: Described as five-finger dexterous hands for realistic grasping and manipulation (africasatellite.com).

items: LiDAR, depth cameras, and infrared cameras under 'Engine Sense' concept (africasatellite.com)

compute.description: Dual processors from NVIDIA and Intel (Maginative).

actuators.description: Self-developed harmonic joint modules; maximum joint torque up to 330 N·m (Maginative); aerospace-grade aluminum body.

availability.notes: No official price or purchase path found. Unofficial reseller africasatellite.com lists SE01 at $54,000, but this is not verified and not an official channel.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: SE01 is described as having five-finger dexterous hands for realistic grasping and manipulation, but no demonstration of manipulation tasks or success rates was found.
caveats: Only a spec claim of dexterous hands; no video or independent evidence of grasping.
Wikipedia mentions SE01 can grasp, but no details or video.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: No evidence of autonomous task execution. Walking demos do not disclose whether they are autonomous or teleoperated.
caveats: All demos are walking-related; no task execution shown.
Teleoperation status not disclosed for any video.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: SE01 is claimed to achieve a natural, human-like walking gait at up to 2 m/s using an end-to-end neural network, reinforcement learning, and imitation learning with self-developed harmonic joint modules. Official and third-party video titles suggest walking demonstrations, including a long-distance campus test. However, no independent biomechanical analysis or teleoperation disclosure is available.
caveats: Claims and video titles only; no independent verification of gait quality.
Teleoperation status not disclosed; autonomy cannot be credited.
Height conflict between sources (1.6 m vs 1.7 m).

perception_scene_understanding.summary: SE01 is reported to have multiple sensors: three stereo camera sets (Maginative) and LiDAR, depth, and infrared cameras under the 'Engine Sense' concept (africasatellite.com). No perception capabilities have been demonstrated.
caveats: Spec claims only; no demonstration of obstacle avoidance, scene understanding, or navigation.

human_interaction.summary: No evidence of human interaction capabilities (speech, gesture, HRI) found.
caveats: No mention of interaction features in reviewed sources.

endurance_reliability.summary: Unofficial reseller lists battery endurance around 2 hours with quick-swap design. A third-party video title suggests a long-distance campus walking test, but no distance or duration data is provided.
caveats: Battery endurance is from an unofficial source and not confirmed.
No reliability test data, uptime logs, or long-duration walking metrics.

human_environment_fit.summary: SE01 is human-sized (170 cm, 55 kg) with human-like proportions, designed to fit environments built for humans.
caveats: No safety certification or real-environment deployment evidence.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: No named customer deployment, sales to end users, or production delivery evidence found. Maginative reported a company target of 1,000 units by 2025, but that is an unverified claim.
caveats: No customer press release or verified deployment.
Production targets are not evidence of actual delivery.

accessibility_value.summary: Unofficial reseller africasatellite.com lists SE01 for $54,000, but no official price or purchase path exists.
caveats: Reseller price is not official and may be unreliable.
No official contact-sales or waitlist information found in reviewed sources.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: SE01 is EngineAI's first full-size biped humanoid, notable for company claims of natural human-like gait achieved via end-to-end neural networks. Evidence is limited to walking demos/titles and spec claims; no autonomous task execution, manipulation, customer deployment, or official pricing.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official site claim of world's first humanoid with human-like walking gait.
Multiple videos (official and third-party) with titles suggesting SE01 walking, including a long-distance campus test.
Specs from media: 170 cm, 55 kg, 32 DoF, 2 m/s, 330 Nm joint torque, dual processors, stereo cameras.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No manipulation or task execution demo.
No customer deployment or sales figures.
No independent verification of gait quality.
conflicting_claims: Height: official 170 cm vs DigiAlps 1.6 m.
Battery endurance ~2 h from unofficial reseller; no official confirmation.
Some sources mention LiDAR/IR sensors while others mention stereo cameras; unclear if both.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit SE01 with manipulation skills based only on 'dexterous hands' spec.
Do not treat reseller price as official.
Do not infer autonomy from walking demos.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: EngineAI SE01 is a full-size biped humanoid (170 cm, 55 kg, 32 DoF) introduced in October 2024 as the company's first humanoid with a natural, human-like walking gait. The gait is achieved through end-to-end neural networks, reinforcement learning, and imitation learning using self-developed harmonic joint modules. Specs include 330 Nm joint torque, dual NVIDIA/Intel processors, and stereo cameras (plus LiDAR/depth/IR per unofficial source). Evidence consists of official and third-party videos with titles indicating walking demos, including a long-distance campus test, but no transcripts or independent analysis. There is no evidence of autonomous task execution, manipulation beyond a spec claim of dexterous hands, customer deployment, or official pricing.
strongest_evidence: Official website claim of world's first humanoid with human-like walking gait (evidence_001).
Official and third-party video titles suggesting SE01 walking demos (evidence_008-012).
Media-reported specs: 170 cm, 55 kg, 32 DoF, 2 m/s, 330 Nm (evidence_002, evidence_003).
weakest_evidence: No manipulation, autonomy, or deployment evidence.
Battery endurance only from unofficial reseller (evidence_006).
known_do_not_credit: Manipulation capabilities based solely on hand spec.
